howtos.title: Route all wiki edits through one curator agent
howtos.what: Harrison Chase says agents can't reliably edit a wiki, so one separate curator agent should make every edit.
copy: Don't let your main agent or subagents edit the wiki directly.
Have a separate curator agent make all the edits.
howtos.whenToUse: When several agents share a wiki or knowledge base and its content keeps drifting.

howtos.title: Share one team list of bots that own app areas
howtos.what: Ryan Carson's team runs Devin Bots like employees that own parts of the app, shared by the whole team.
copy: Give each Bot ownership of a part of the app or the engineering process.
Keep one shared list of the Bots for the team.
Have everyone talk to the same Bots.
howtos.whenToUse: When each teammate runs private agents and context is getting split across them.
